package domain

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestNormalizeStudentOnboardingTreatsSelfAssessmentAsProfileData(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	profile, err := NormalizeStudentOnboarding(StudentOnboarding{
		StudentID:              "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		DirectionCode:          " Backend ",
		SelfAssessedExperience: " basic ",
		KnownStacks:            []string{" Go ", "go", " PostgreSQL "},
		DesiredStacks:          []string{"Go", " Docker "},
		GoalCode:               "first-job",
		GoalText:               " Получить первую работу ",
		PreferredLanguage:      "ru",
		WeeklyMinutes:          300,
		PreferredPace:          "balanced",
		Version:                1,
		CreatedAt:              now,
		UpdatedAt:              now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("normalize onboarding: %v", err)
	}
	if profile.DirectionCode != "backend" || profile.SelfAssessedExperience != "basic" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected normalized profile: %+v", profile)
	}
	if len(profile.KnownStacks) != 2 || profile.KnownStacks[0] != "go" || profile.KnownStacks[1] != "postgresql" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected known stacks: %#v", profile.KnownStacks)
	}
	if profile.GoalText != "Получить первую работу" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected goal text: %q", profile.GoalText)
	}
}

func TestNormalizeStudentOnboardingRejectsInvalidBounds(t *testing.T) {
	_, err := NormalizeStudentOnboarding(StudentOnboarding{
		StudentID:              "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		DirectionCode:          "backend",
		SelfAssessedExperience: "basic",
		DesiredStacks:          []string{"go"},
		GoalCode:               "first-job",
		PreferredLanguage:      "ru",
		WeeklyMinutes:          0,
		PreferredPace:          "balanced",
		Version:                1,
		CreatedAt:              time.Now(),
		UpdatedAt:              time.Now(),
	})
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid weekly minutes accepted")
	}
}
